description: Rb₂NaMoI₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent I atoms to form RbI₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbI₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbI₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaI₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoI₆ octahedra. All Rb-I bond lengths are 4.23 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoI₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbI₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.16 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form MoI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbI₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-I bond lengths are 2.82 Å. I is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom.
